title: Newton’s Prism & Dust Lab
summary: An interactive Three.js optical workshop tracing sixteen spectral wavelengths through a rotating crown-glass prism, lens, and mirror.
description: An interactive Three.js / WebGL2 optical bench and 30-second short film. A shutter admits a single shaft of sunlight through a rotating crown-glass prism, dispersing sixteen wavelengths from indigo to crimson across a brass mirror, biconvex lens, and water-filled sphere onto ruled parchment.
